g.text: Cross-Pod File Resolution and Content Streaming
begin and lock all IDs in stable order
require same Session, READY, and active
GET content with session_id, file_id, and expected SHA-256
Resolve is all-or-nothing and preserves request order.
Runtime stores only a trusted metadata snapshot with the User Entry.
Backpressure and cancellation propagate through the content stream.
No local file or complete in-memory object is created.
